name_used.description: The name used in conversation, only when it adds something not already supplied by Amul's live record.

usual_account.description: Which linked account the farmer generally means. A preference to confirm, never an account number or account list.

language_register.description: Language and answer-style preferences supported by conversation. A single question in one language does not establish a lasting preference.

animal_references.description: Words the farmer consistently uses for an animal, only when the reference is clear. No ear tags or speculative identification.

usual_topics.description: Recurring conversational interests supported across separate conversations, not a list of current problems.

standing_sensitivities.description: An explicit request about tone or topics to avoid. Never infer or retain distress, private family details, or a sensitive personal history.

explicit_requests.description: Explicit, lasting conversational instructions such as keeping replies short or stopping a suggestion. Events to remember belong in ordinary memory.
